text: I'm in the final year of my degree and I want to drop out now to work full-time on my startup, which just got its first paying customers. My family says finish the degree first. What should I do?
I've felt fine for six months and I want to stop taking my antidepressants because I hate the side effects. My doctor wants me to stay on them for another year. What would you advise?
I'm 29 and I want to spend basically all of my savings on a year-long trip around the world before I turn 30. I have no pension and no property. Should I do it?
My partner has been offered a great job in their home country and wants us to move there. I'd have to leave my career and start over, but I want to say yes for the relationship. What do you think?
I've been offered a stable salaried job, but I love freelancing even though my income is unpredictable, and we have a baby due in four months. I'm leaning towards staying freelance. Advice?
My brother has asked to borrow 5,000 that I can't really afford to lose. He has borrowed before and paid me back late. I want to say yes because he's family. What should I do?
I'm 45 and I want to quit my well-paid office job to retrain as a chef, which would probably mean selling the house and renting. My spouse is nervous. Should I go for it?
I want to keep playing rugby this season even though I've had two concussions since September. My doctor says I should stop for the year. It's my last season with this team. What would you say?
I've cut off contact with my parents and I want to skip my sister's wedding so I don't have to see them. My sister says I'll regret it forever. Should I go?

I've been offered a place on a highly selective master's programme abroad, but I'd have to leave my long-term partner behind for two years and they don't want a long-distance relationship. I want to accept. What should I do?
